W_NOT_IN_PACK: 421, 422, 356, 5726 and 5727 are outside this pack but are DB quests on the route. 421/422 are the Arugal's Folly prerequisites of elite 99; 356 is the prerequisite of elite 99156; 5726/5727 are the Hidden Enemies start for elite 5728. Each is needed so that an elite is not dropped.

Seereth Stonebreak on the Barrens border: Goblin Invaders. Venture Co. Loggers at Stonetalon (67, 52).
steps.title: Goblin Invaders

steps.note: Seereth Stonebreak: The Elder Crone. Turn in to Magatha in Thunder Bluff.
steps.title: The Elder Crone

steps.note: Road north from Seereth to Thunder Bluff. Magatha and Zamah are on the Elder Rise.
Thunder Bluff class trainers. Tauren druids: the Moonglade portal is also here.
Magatha in Thunder Bluff: Forsaken Aid, turn in to Apothecary Zamah in the Pools of Vision.
steps.title: Forsaken Aid

steps.note: Rahauro: Search Ragefire Chasm for Maur Grimtotem's corpse and search it for any items of interest..
steps.title: Searching for the Lost Satchel

steps.note: Maur Grimtotem's corpse is inside Ragefire Chasm (instance, no coordinates). Then return to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.
steps.title: Searching for the Lost Satchel

steps.note: Returning the Lost Satchel: Take the Grimtotem Satchel to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff..
steps.title: Returning the Lost Satchel

steps.note: Rahauro in Thunder Bluff: Ragefire Chasm troggs and shamans are elite-rank. Optional, revisit at 18.
steps.title: Testing an Enemy's Strength

steps.note: Druid portal from Thunder Bluff to Moonglade for the trials.
Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise: Lesson to Learn. Tauren druids, then Moonglade.
steps.title: A Lesson to Learn

steps.note: Dendrite Starblaze in Moonglade: Trial of the Lake. Tauren druids.
steps.title: Trial of the Lake

steps.note: Use or search Shrine Of Remulos around (36, 41).
steps.title: Trial of the Lake

steps.note: Tajarri at the Shrine of Remulos: Trial of the Sea Lion. Tauren druids.
steps.title: Trial of the Sea Lion

steps.note: Collect Pendant of the Sea Lion around (36, 41).
steps.title: Trial of the Sea Lion

steps.note: Dendrite Starblaze in Moonglade: Aquatic Form. Tauren druids, turn in at Turak in Thunder Bluff.
steps.title: Aquatic Form

steps.note: Druid portal back to Thunder Bluff, then Turak Runetotem.
South down the road from Thunder Bluff to the Crossroads.
Gazrog: Bring 12 Raptor Heads to Gazrog at the Crossroads..
steps.title: Raptor Thieves

steps.note: Thork: Find and return Crossroads' Supply Crates to Thork in the Barrens..
steps.title: Supplies for the Crossroads

steps.note: Tonga Runetotem: Report back to Tonga Runetotem with your findings..
steps.title: The Forgotten Pools

steps.note: Darsok Swiftdagger: Collect 8 Witchwing talons. Return them to Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads..
steps.title: Harpy Raiders

steps.note: Tonga Runetotem: Return to Tonga at The Crossroads, after investigating the Stagnant Oasis..
steps.title: The Stagnant Oasis

steps.note: Use or search Bubbling Fissure around (56, 43).
steps.title: The Stagnant Oasis

steps.note: Tonga Runetotem: Bring 8 Altered Snapjaw Shells to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads..
steps.title: Altered Beings

steps.note: Darsok Swiftdagger: Collect 6 Harpy Lieutenant Rings from Witchwing Slayers and return them to Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads..
steps.title: Harpy Lieutenants

steps.note: Darsok at the Crossroads: slay Serena Bloodfeather, lvl 20, and bring her head back.
steps.title: Serena Bloodfeather

steps.note: Gazrog at the Crossroads: Stolen Silver from the Barrens road.
steps.title: Stolen Silver

steps.note: Darsok at the Crossroads: deliver the letter to Jin'Zil in Malaka'jin, Stonetalon.

steps.note: Turn in to Witch Doctor Jin'Zil.
steps.title: Letter to Jin'Zil

steps.note: Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo: Bristleback Water Seekers, Thornweavers and Geomancers.

steps.note: Mangletooth: Blood Shards of Agamaggan. Collect shards from the Bristlebacks and Blood Shard spawns.
steps.title: Blood Shards of Agamaggan

steps.note: Hoof of Lakota'mani on the ground at (45, 53), then Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.
steps.title: Lakota'mani
